semantics: Delete a seeded subset of the old 100K base and append the same number of previously excluded reserve vectors; rebuild at fixed cardinality.
certification: Each deployable method is accepted only when the independent 500-query target one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson UCB is <=0.05; otherwise use the target-certified fixed fallback.
tcp_note: Nine source builds have alpha floor 0.10. Any 5% safety conclusion in M3 comes from independent target-query certification, not a 5% exchangeable-build theorem.
recovery_accounting: Target-retrained DARTH and refreshed TCP pool are recovery comparators; their training, truth, and rebuild costs are not treated as zero.
